newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Costello sees no investment forecast change.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Costello sees no investment forecast change.

text.p: Australian Treasurer Peter Costello said there was no need for the government to revise its budget forecasts for investment.
Asked in parliament whether there was such a need, Costello said: "No."
In its August budget, the government forecast 14 percent year-average business investment for the fiscal year to June 1997.
Figures earlier on Tuesday showed merchandise imports rose one percent in October, although imports capital goods fell seven percent.
Economists said the fall off in capital goods imports was further evidence of the subdued economy and suggested the business investment forecast for the 1996/97 year might not be met.
